title: Free Hungry Jack's Cheeseburger (in-Store or via Drive-Thru) or with $1 Minimum Spend Online (NBL27 Round 10) @Hungry Jack's App
body:
Deal: Free Hungry Jack's Cheeseburger (in-Store or via Drive-Thru) or with $1 Minimum Spend Online (NBL27 Round 10) @Hungry Jack's App

[new2onlineshopping] For those who prefer to manually enter it in the NBL app, or directly on the NBL website, here , the codeword for tonight's game (Tasmania JackJumpers v Illawarra Hawks) is BOXSCORE .
I will (or other users can) reply to this comment with further codewords as they are announced during this current NBL27 Round 10.
[new2onlineshopping] Enjoy this while you can (for the next three days).
There's a ten-day break between the end of this round and the start of the next round. Possibly longer for the next codeword, if at all.
[AsukaST] So this link will expire on Sunday but
Enjoy this while you can (for the next three days)
is there another one on Tuesday?
[new2onlineshopping] No, but click on the direct link tomorrow (Sunday) and your voucher will expire on Monday. Free cheeseburgers today, tomorrow, and Monday. Enjoy!
[wizzlesticks] Is there even a $1 spend? Like maybe have to order sauces.
[Orgazmo] Seems like depending what staff you get. I always order at cashier rather than in app and it's no spend required.
[AsukaST] if you go instore and order at the counter, there is no min spend.
[cloudy] Is this one burger per account? Or can you do it over and over?
[AsukaST] It's one per account, but you may open a few accounts and get a few free burgers.
But the cashier will stop you to redeem multiple burgers at one time, so you will need go to different stores, or come back in a few hours for another cashier.
[MELso] I know it's not the OzB way, but a small chips for $2 to accompany the burger is my go to (although you can order at the counter)…
[new2onlineshopping] No deal.
Free small chips or $2 large chips, both via Shake and Win.
[doubleclutching] Add an extra beef patty to the cheeseburger for $2.
[huang297] Small frozen drinks are $1 (cept the keri orange and mango one)
[Zonda] Thank you. This is one of only a few reasons I check OzBargain these days.
